description: Find a DIY Halloween costume you can actually make from what you already own.

defaultPrompt: What can I make with cardboard and tape?
I need a last-minute costume I can make tonight.
I need a quick costume for my 3-year-old and I have a bedsheet.
interface.longDescription: Pick My Costume ranks 169 curated Halloween costumes by how much you can already build. Tell it who's dressing up and what you already own, and it shows which costumes your materials cover best. Search by a specific item to see exactly what you'd still need for each. Every costume has a materials list, step-by-step build guide, and estimated time and effort, with safety notes for most. You can also narrow by vibe, interests, and effort level. No account or signup required.
